summary: Phase 149O.20L.7L.6 -- Contract-Preamble and Relative-Import Guard Repair Independent Verification. FINAL VERDICT: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- REPAIR COMPLETE; SOURCE-SCOPE FINDING CLOSED. Verification-only phase; independently re-derived 149O.20L.7L.5's own claims from live contract/production/test state, never trusting its narrative. (1) Section 0 preamble repair (contract section 58.1): independently read src/pcae/core/hatp_mandatory_cutover.py lines 842-853 and confirmed no hard-coded mandatory_consumption_implementation_independently_verified = False assignment exists anywhere in the file, and the cited line range holds unrelated substrate-readiness/signing-availability code. Confirmed the readiness term is computed by a fresh, uncached call to validate_active_hatp_mandatory_independent_verification_certification, mapped to True only via exact CertificationStatus.VALID identity (certification_status_satisfies_readiness: 'return status is CertificationStatus.VALID', read directly from source), fail-closed on every other status and any exception. Confirmed zero stored certification artifacts exist anywhere on this host (registry.json/repository-identity.json/deployment-binding.json/certifications.json/certification-bindings.json/active-certification.json all absent), so the readiness term still evaluates False today. Read the current preamble text directly (not from any phase narrative) and confirmed it names this mechanism accurately and explicitly disclaims HMIC certification, HATP activation readiness, Boundary C completion, first use, and DeploymentBinding existence -- no overstatement found. Confirmed the repair is same-version (no new HMIC-REQ-### identifier introduced; HMIC-001 remains v1.4). (2) Whole-document stale-current-claim re-scan, independent of 149O.20L.7L.5's own: grepped every 'hard-coded'/'not yet operative'/'no caller'/stale-file-count occurrence in the contract and confirmed each remaining hit sits inside an archival Phase-history paragraph, an already-corrected 'operative, not yet consequential' attack-matrix row, or a normative-requirement citation -- none is a live, present-tense, uncorrected restatement of the old defect outside the (now-repaired) preamble. The one archival occurrence of the exact stale sentence, inside Phase 149O.19.3R's own historical narrative, was confirmed to correctly remain byte-preserved (historical truth, not a live claim). (3) Previously repaired sections (attack rows 33/34/36/37/38/39, HMIC-REQ-050, HMIC-REQ-052, HMIC-REQ-145) independently re-extracted from the 149O.20L.7L.3 commit and from HEAD and confirmed byte-identical block-for-block. (4) Thirty-member frozen-authority-bearing-file set independently reconstructed from hmic._FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES (30 exact paths, matching the contract's own enumeration) and implementation_scope_digest independently recomputed live via hmic.derive_implementation_scope_digest, matching 65ff8ab06b5cd7feb2505742cfbb112ffd386c5b2cf34c2d7f3446d92afe15b8 exactly. git diff --name-only <phase-entry>...HEAD confirmed empty for src/pcae/ and scripts/. (5) AST relative-import guard repair (contract section 58.2/58.3): independently loaded the guard module (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7l_hmic_frozen_source_scope_amendment_independent_verification.py) via importlib and exercised _module_name_for_path directly against regular modules, package __init__.py files (including the top-level pcae/__init__.py), nested packages, and files outside src/pcae -- all matched expected canonical dotted-module derivation. Cross-validated _resolve_relative_import_base line-for-line against Python's own importlib._bootstrap._resolve_name algorithm across level-1 (module and package-__init__ contexts), multilevel, and two independent escape-root cases -- every result matched exactly, including fail-closed None on escape. Independently constructed and ran all F-7L-7 adversarial forms (level-1 from-dot-import, level-1 module-symbol, multilevel via a real pcae.schema_runtime nested-package context, parenthesized/multiline, alias, multi-name, relative and absolute wildcard, absolute plain/alias/importfrom/multiline/alias/multiname/protected-symbol, six negative controls including an unrelated relative import) against real src/pcae/core scratch files with genuine module context -- all detected or correctly negative as expected; wildcard forms correctly landed in the suspicious/wildcard set rather than being silently treated as safe. Constructed independent escape-root and missing-module-context cases and confirmed both fail closed into a synthetic <unresolved-relative ...> wildcard entry, never silently dropped. Ran two independent mutation tests against a disposable copy of the real src/pcae/core/paths.py module (relative-import injection, and a false-positive string-literal-only control) -- detected and clean respectively, as expected. Directly AST-parsed the guard module's own source and confirmed both critical producer-reachability guards (test_no_module_under_src_pcae_imports_the_producer_at_ast_level and test_admin_script_is_the_only_non_test_caller_of_the_producer_entry_points) call only _pcae_import_targets, never _pcae_imports; confirmed the sole remaining _pcae_imports caller in the guard module is test_producer_pair_reaches_no_unbound_pcae_module, which discards the producer module from its own reachable set before asserting -- an unrelated outbound-dependency-completeness check, not a reachability guard, and confirmed no other test module (149O.19.3/149O.19.3R eras) references the DeploymentBinding producer at all. Independently reproduced the pre-repair bug against the immutable pre-149O.20L.7L.5 helper (extracted verbatim from commit d6dd458d) for all three relative forms -- confirmed each was silently missed pre-repair and is now detected post-repair. Independently re-ran the repaired resolver across the entire src/ and scripts/ tree and confirmed zero non-test importers and zero wildcard/unresolved hits of the producer anywhere. Searched all of src/pcae for importlib.import_module/__import__/runpy usage co-occurring with the producer name and confirmed none; searched for any subprocess/Popen/os.system invocation-construct co-occurring with the admin script's path and confirmed none (textual docstring mentions of the path, explaining the Protected Admin ceremony boundary, are expected and were excluded from the invocation check); confirmed pyproject.toml's [project.scripts] exposes only the pcae console entry point, no DeploymentBinding-related one. (6) Regression A/B: built an isolated git worktree at the immutable pre-149O.20L.7L.5 commit (d6dd458d) and ran the identical raw -m fast_green invocation there and on current HEAD today -- exact FAILED/ERROR node-ID diff between the two runs is a single test, test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence, swapping between two different subtests (test_verify_detects_tampered_record vs test_audit_verify_cli) across runs; reran that test class serially three times on current HEAD and reproduced a consistent subprocess.TimeoutExpired on the pcae shell-gate audit verify CLI invocation, confirming a genuine, pre-existing, host-timing-dependent subprocess flake in unrelated shell-gate audit infrastructure, not a regression introduced by, or related in subject matter to, this phase's HMIC/AST-guard/relative-import scope. Zero other differences between the two runs (253 failed/7614 passed/4 skipped/9 errors, identical aggregate and identical node-ID set otherwise). A 263-item deselect list (262 from the raw HEAD run plus the alternate shell-gate flake variant) produces a clean 7613 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped, run twice for stability, identical both times. Verdicts: F-7L-5 CLOSED. F-7L-7 CLOSED. F-7L-1/F-7L-2 confirmed remain CLOSED. 7J section 31 (HMIC frozen-source-membership finding): CLOSED -- both closure-blocking defects (F-7L-5, F-7L-7) are independently verified repaired, the thirty-file/five-member production identity and implementation_scope_digest are independently confirmed correct, and no production behavior changed. No Dell access. No RepositoryIdentity, no DeploymentBinding, no election, no CHGR, no certification, no activation. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable.
